entities.summary: Yemva is a town and the administrative center of Knyazhpogostsky District of the Komi Republic, Russia, located on the Vym River 130 kilometers (81 mi) northeast of Syktyvkar. Population: 14,570 (2010 census); 16,739 (2002 census); 18,782 (1989 Soviet census).
